text:
alex.m: FYI Acme just sent an updated provisioning plan — they're doing a staggered wave delivery across two docks, earlier than we expected but split over 3 days.

acme_rep: Correct — OEM shortage forced staged shipments. Wave 1 (50 units) ETA Wed 09:00 local, Wave 2 (40 units) ETA Thu 15:00, Wave 3 (balance) Fri night. All AWBs attached.

alex.m: can you paste the AWBs here? ops needs them for the inbound schedule. also confirm who handles insurance claim if any transit damage. @karen_logistics

acme_rep: Sure — AWBs:
```
AWB: 123-45678901 (WAVE1)
AWB: 123-45678902 (WAVE2)
AWB: 123-45678903 (WAVE3)
```
Insurance: Acme maintains cargo insurance, but we need the receiver to file local claims for physical damage at depot. We can provide inspection photos and handover docs.

sam_ops: noted. we'll schedule dock windows for Wed/Thu/Fri. can we get tentative arrival windows (2h blocks)? also need pallet weight/stacking to allocate lift ops.

acme_rep: Wave1 window 09:00-11:00, Wave2 14:00-16:00, Wave3 20:00-22:00. Pallet dims: 120x100x150 cm, ~380kg each, 10 pallets total across waves.

maria.g: routing question — some H100s are reserved for EU Dedicated pool and others for hosted. we need serial ranges to tag inventory to customers asap. acme, can you include unit serials in the manifest rather than a separate file? reduces manual reconciliation.

acme_rep: We'll attach full serial manifest to the POD email. provisional manifests attached to this thread now.

leo_procure: pricing ask — because of the phased delivery we're seeing an extra staging charge of $650/wave. can we negotiate to waive the Wave3 staging fee since it's an outside-peak late-night delivery? @acme_rep

acme_rep: I can push for Wave3 staging waived if Redwood covers customs broker standby fee ($200). Else we can discount $400 off the staging total.

alex.m: prefer cost off staging. operations, any objections to the $400 discount trade?

karen_logistics: fine with that if procurement signs off. also: we had one DOA incident last shipment — request acme to include RMA labels in the pallet envelope for direct depot returns. speeds resolution.

acme_rep: understood. RMA labels and return flow docs will be included. For DOA, local depot does first-line replacement, vendor handles final RMA. We'll include kit number and return SLAs.

sam_ops: can you confirm RMA SLA in hours? we typically need ship-back labels within 24h of failure report.

acme_rep: Standard is 48h for issuing return auth and labels. We can expedite to 24h for reserved fleet SKUs (you have a commitment).

leo_procure: confirm which SKUs count as reserved fleet. list?

maria.g: reserved = H100-80GB (sku: H100-R8), H200-64GB (sku: H200-R6). others are pooled.

procurement-bot: Reminder: PO-4512 has a hold for staged-invoice review. Please approve by EOD to avoid payment delay.

alex.m: I'll ping finance. one more ops detail — customs HS code mismatch last time caused 12h delay. acme, please add HS 8471.80 to the manifest and commercial invoice.

acme_rep: Will add HS 8471.80 on all docs. Also flagging that Wave2 may hit a customs spot-check; advise to keep an extra hour buffer.

karen_logistics: we'll add buffer into the dock booking. also request crate-level photos for inbound inspection to reduce disputes for insurance claims.

acme_rep: We'll upload crate photos 24h prior to each wave to the shared S3 folder. Link: https://s3.acme-example.com/redwood/inbound/1719801234

sam_ops: perfect. final ask: please include a PO-linked packing list filename convention so our parser picks it up automatically (e.g., PO4512_packing_wave1.csv).

acme_rep: done — naming will be PO4512_packing_wave{n}.csv and manifest_sernums_wave{n}.csv.

leo_procure: i'll confirm the staging discount and update the PO addendum. once PO is updated, procurement-bot can release final invoice.

alex.m: thanks everyone. i'll watch for the crate photos and manifests. if any DOA shows up, open #incidents and cc procurement. :thumbsup:

karen_logistics: ACK. prepping dock crew.

acme_rep: thanks — we'll send final POD and AWB scans after each wave completes.
